name: Cargo Century
summary: A transport tycoon in the browser, in the spirit of Transport Giant: real maps of European regions, rail, road and sea lines, goods chains and towns that grow, played alone or with up to eight people.
clayform: All 118 buildings, industries, stations, trees and vehicles are Clayform scenes. The game's build meshes each one, stops on any critic error, reduces it to a triangle budget and packs them all into one compressed file.
imageAlt: 24 of Cargo Century's Clayform models: factories, a church, a town hall, houses, trees, a crane, trains, a lorry and a plane. The company colour is shown in blue; in the game it is each player's colour.
